name: General Construction
tagline: Buildings, roads and civil works delivered with discipline.
heroText: Integrated building and civil-works delivery for public, commercial, industrial and community infrastructure, with disciplined project management, quality control and HSE.
heroAlt: Donmac site team in safety equipment
intro: Donmac coordinates design inputs, procurement, site mobilisation, civil and structural works, finishing, inspection and handover through one accountable delivery team. For road works, our scope can include formation and earthworks, subgrade and base preparation, drainage, surfacing, road furniture and routine or periodic maintenance, delivered to the applicable client and statutory requirements.
